description: Orthographic full-screen pixel-art RPG Codex interface reference, D&D dark fantasy dragon style, blackened steel and smoky obsidian, restrained antique silver and tiny ruby accents. One title well, one upper-right navigation action, three calm content columns. The six left navigation actions must use the same ornate dark-metal dragon-claw plate language as a heroic main menu, with quiet neutral silver focus rather than bright yellow. Empty interiors only, no text, no letters, no pseudo-text, no characters, no portraits, no icons, no watermark. Crisp stable borders, identical button silhouettes for every state, generous safe zones, no ornament inside content rectangles.
